title: Admissibility-Preserving Constraint Lifting for Conditional Deadbeat Control of Discrete-Time Nonlinear Systems
summary: This paper presents a constraint-enforcing control framework for a class of discrete-time strict- feedback nonlinear systems. The objective is to guarantee closed-loop stability while ensuring forward invariance of a prescribed safe set defined by state constraints. The pro- posed approach transforms the constrained control problem into an equivalent unconstrained one through smooth constraint-lifting mappings constructed using strictly increasing sigmoid functions.
